newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ailing east German aluminium plant back on stream.
newsitem.headline: Ailing east German aluminium plant back on stream.

text.p: Ailing east German aluminium processor Rackwitz resumed production after interim finance was found, receiver Winfrid Andres said.
Andres told Reuters on Monday he was confident a new owner would be found by the middle of the year as there was enough serious interest.
Until that time, the plant would be able to operate on 13 million marks raised from banks, the states of Saxony and Saxony Anhalt and the Bonn government.

The plant in 1995 produced 1,800 tonnes per month of processed metal, mostly foil and continuously-cast sections for use in the building sector at two sites in Rackwitz and Merseburg, which together employ 450.
Rackwitz filed for bankruptcy proceedings on December 17.
